evidence.summary: 5-angle capture reads as a coherent Tudor half-timbered cottage: 29x21.6 bbox matches config, 7-stud plank door, 3 mullioned windows, timber bands/posts, slate roof+ridge, brick chimney, cobble base.

reasons: All brief-required features present and textured on capture from front/back/left/right/iso
Bounding box 29x21.6 and 7-stud door match config and human scale
Matches reference signature (dark timber on cream plaster, slate roof, brick chimney); above generic bar
Minor: gable ends plain, timbering sparser than real references - not brief violations

config.style: Tudor half-timbered cottage: cream plaster walls with dark timber corner posts/bands, slate pitched gable roof with ridge cap and overhang, 7-stud plank door with jambs+stoop, 3 framed mullioned windows, brick chimney, cobblestone slab base

steps: get_references('stone cottage gable roof') - noted signature features: pitched gable roof, chimney stack, framed multi-pane windows, contrasting timber/masonry facade
Assembled 60-part Model at (150,0,150): 26x18 footprint, 10-stud walls from segmented plaster parts leaving a 5x7 door opening and 5x4 window openings
Gable wedges + two angled slate roof slabs with 1.5-stud eave overhang and ridge cap; brick chimney punching through the roof plane
Timber detailing: corner posts, top/mid facade bands, door frame, window frames + muntins over glass panes; cobblestone floor slab and stoop
capture_angles round 1 caught inverted roof/gables (V-valley); flipped wedge yaw and slab pitch signs; round 2 confirmed correct pitched silhouette from front/left/iso

recipe.text: Built a Tudor half-timbered cottage (distinct from prior stone structure-house artifacts) entirely from primitives in one run_luau pass: segmented walls form real openings (7-stud doorway, walk-through capable), WedgeParts close the gables, two rotated slabs form the roof. Materials: Concrete plaster + Wood timber + Slate roof + Brick chimney + Glass windows for a coherent palette. First capture round revealed the roof angle signs were inverted; fixed and re-verified from 3 angles. Door is CanCollide=false so a character can enter.
